bodies.markdown:
这是 **Zalith-Plain Craft Launcher** 的 1.2.1 版本。

- 版本号：1.2.1

### 修复

- **「检查更新」点了没反应**：更新弹窗原来只由原生界面渲染，PCL 界面里没有宿主 —— 即使已经查到新版本，界面上也不会有任何反应。现在 PCL 界面也有 PCL 风格的更新弹窗（含多架构安装包选择），「关于」页会明确告诉你结果（已是最新 / 获取失败 / 太频繁 / 超时）；国内额外接入 jsDelivr 镜像，整次检查 60 秒封顶，不会再一直转圈。
- **搜索资源后点进详情再返回，搜索词被清空**：搜索关键词、筛选条件、结果列表原来跟着页面一起销毁，返回后得重新输一遍。现在按分栏记住这些状态（含当前页码与结果列表），返回即接着看。
- **正版登录被拒**：构建期读取正版登录 client id 时没去掉行尾换行，注入值被污染，刷新令牌接口直接返回 `invalid_grant`，表现为「原版能登录、本启动器提示凭据已被拒绝」。
- **切换深/浅色闪退**：Android 15/16 上窗口没有有效 surface 时 `PixelCopy` 会直接抛异常；现在失败自动重试并降级为无动画切换。
- **主题切换偶发不生效**：截屏失败时不回调换色逻辑，表现为「点了深色没反应」。
- **Forge 安装报 NullPointerException**：原版 json/jar 之前按自定义名安装，Forge 的 `inheritsFrom` 找不到原版；现在一律落在 `versions/<原版名>/`。
- **首页右侧日志「清空」无效**：只清了内存缓冲，界面又回退到磁盘上的旧日志。

### 改进

- **「你知道吗」只显示官网审核过的内容**，内置文案已删除；点一下卡片文字即可换一条，顶栏的「自定义主页 / 刷新主页」与卡片上的刷新按钮已去掉。
- **回声洞进入即加载**，不再需要点一下才显示内容。
- **游戏内悬浮菜单、联机菜单跟随界面风格**：PCL 界面下是 PCL 观感，切回 ZL 界面恢复原生样式。
- **游戏退出/崩溃页在 PCL 界面下换成 PCL 观感**（自绘标题栏、卡片布局、PCL 按钮）。
- **版本设置新增「登录方式」，支持第三方登录**：正版登录或离线登录 / 仅正版登录 / 仅离线登录 / 第三方登录：统一通行证 / 第三方登录：Authlib Injector 或 LittleSkin；选第三方时填认证服务器（统一通行证填服务器 ID）、注册链接与服务器名称，支持一键「设置为 LittleSkin」，启动该版本时本地没有对应账户会当场登录。
- **「功能隐藏」新增恢复手势**：勾掉某个入口后，在右下角连点 10 次可临时显示所有被隐藏的入口 30 秒，趁这段时间去「设置 → 个性化」取消勾选即可。
- **第三方登录支持多角色选择**：同一个账号下有多个角色时，登录后弹出角色列表让你自己挑；登录完成后主页显示皮肤头像与角色名，并提供「修改皮肤 / 刷新」「服务器网站」「切换账号」。
- **登录方式的图标与胶囊换成 PCL 原版样式**（人物 + 列表图标、半透明底、圆角 13），不再是自己拼的样子。
- **所有确认 / 提示框在 PCL 界面下统一为 PCL 风格**：`#FBFBFB` 底、5dp 圆角、按钮顺序按 PCL 原版「确定」在左「取消」在右；游戏内「强制关闭」、控制布局替换提示等不再弹出 Material 胶囊框。
- **控制布局「导入布局（.json）」修好**：之前点了没有任何反应（事件发给了没人接的页面），现在导入成功会提示数量、失败会提示原因。

### 注意

- **包名从 `com.movtery.zalithlauncher` 改为 `com.zalith.pcl`**：因此 1.2 是一个全新应用，**不能覆盖安装 1.1**，装完桌面上会多出新的图标，请手动卸载旧版。游戏存档、Mod、资源包都在共享存储里，不受影响；启动器自身的设置与已登录的账户会重新开始。

This is **Zalith-Plain Craft Launcher** 1.2.1.

- Version: 1.2.1

### Fixes

- **"Check for updates" did nothing**: the update dialog was only rendered by the native UI, so in PCL UI mode a discovered version had nowhere to show up. It now has a PCL-style dialog (with multi-architecture APK picker) and the About page reports the outcome (up to date / failed / too frequent / timed out). A jsDelivr mirror was added for mainland China and the whole check is capped at 60 seconds.
- **Search results were reset after opening a mod and going back**: the keyword, filters and result list died with the page. They are now remembered per category (including the current page and its results).
- **Microsoft login rejected**: a trailing newline leaked into the OAuth client id at build time, causing `invalid_grant` on token refresh.
- **Crash when switching light/dark theme** on Android 15/16 (`PixelCopy` without a backing surface); capture failures now retry and fall back to a non-animated switch.
- **Theme switch sometimes had no effect** when capture failed.
- **Forge installation NullPointerException**: vanilla json/jar are now placed under `versions/<vanilla name>/` so `inheritsFrom` resolves.
- **Home log "clear" did not work** — the on-disk log was shown again immediately.

### Improvements

- **"Did you know" only shows content approved on the website**; built-in texts were removed. Tap the text to load another one.
- **Echo cave loads on entry** instead of requiring a tap.
- **In-game floating menu and multiplayer menu follow the UI style** (PCL vs. native ZL).
- **Game exit/crash page uses the PCL look** in PCL UI mode.
- **Version setup gained "Login method" with third-party login**: Microsoft or offline / Microsoft only / offline only / Unified Passport / Authlib Injector or LittleSkin. Configure the auth server (or server ID), register link and server name — “Set to LittleSkin” fills them in one tap; launching prompts for credentials when no account for that server exists.
- **"Hide features" gained a recovery gesture**: after hiding entries, tap the bottom-right corner 10 times to reveal them for 30 seconds.
- **Third-party login supports role selection**: when one account owns several roles, a role list pops up after signing in; the home page then shows the skin avatar and role name with "Edit skin / Refresh", "Server website" and "Switch account".
- **Login method icon and capsule follow the original PCL look** (person + list icon, translucent fill, 13 radius).
- **All confirm / notice dialogs use the PCL style in PCL UI mode**: `#FBFBFB` background, 5dp corner, PCL's original button order (OK on the left, Cancel on the right). In-game "force close" and control-layout prompts no longer show a Material pill dialog.
- **Control layout "Import layout (.json)" fixed**: it used to do nothing at all; now it reports how many items were imported, or the reason it failed.

### Note

- **The package name changed from `com.movtery.zalithlauncher` to `com.zalith.pcl`**, so 1.2 is a brand-new app: it **cannot be installed over 1.1**, and you will get a second icon — uninstall the old one manually. Saves, mods and resource packs in shared storage are unaffected; the launcher's own settings and signed-in accounts start fresh.
